name: Bézier-boundary gradient approximation
definition: A strategy to approximate the gradients of a discontinuous indicator function g(·) with respect to control point coordinates, enabling backpropagation in Gaussian Splatting despite g(·) being piecewise constant and non-differentiable.
summary: Bézier-boundary gradient approximation enables backpropagation in Gaussian Splatting by approximating gradients of discontinuous indicator functions via geometric boundary analysis, unlike standard differentiable rendering.
